scripts.build: pnpm build:core && pnpm exec tsc -b packages/ui && pnpm --filter @aeon/chrome-extension build
scripts.build:core: pnpm exec tsc -b packages/domain packages/protocol apps/daemon packages/pi-adapter packages/store apps/cli && pnpm --filter @aeon/native-host build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm exec tsc -b packages/domain packages/protocol apps/daemon packages/pi-adapter packages/store apps/cli packages/ui --pretty false && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p apps/chrome-extension/tsconfig.json
scripts.lint: eslint apps packages scripts --max-warnings=0 && node scripts/check-boundaries.mjs && node scripts/check-source-limits.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm agent-text:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm test
